text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(At first, my body couldn't keep up... 
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I drilled the movements I struggled with 
into my body dozens, hundreds of times. 
This—is the result.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A smile!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your moves are perfect! But what about 
your smile?! Where did that smile go, 
Believe-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your face, which is as adorable as a 
kitty's, is going to waste! Smile like 
this, like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yah! Bakushin-shi-i-in!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Even if the moves are 
messy, as long as you're smiling! It looks 
great, right? In dance! Facial expressions 
are everything!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
T-That sounds like a bit of an extreme 
take, too...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Facial expressions... I'm not really 
sure... I thought mannerisms were 
everything...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's advice from a senior 
sprinter. It has merit. Trainer, I...
choice_data_list: Give it the best smile you can right now!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Natural... Yes. If you force yourself, it 
will only result in a forced expression.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The emotions welling up from the bottom of 
my heart... If only a fraction of them 
could reach my expression...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Like... this...? Or maybe, like this...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaa--!! More, give it more! Miss 
Believe, let that hidden passion of yours 
explode!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Keep up with me! Hup! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Urya... urya...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Sakura Bakushin O, Believe did her 
best to muster a smile.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The best I can do right now... You're 
right. If I do nothing, nothing will 
change.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Even with smiling, if I practice hundreds 
of times, I'm sure... All right...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Heh... hehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that nice! It's getting better, 
but still a long way to go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In order to smile with all our hearts—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right, let us remember the taste of mame 
daifuku!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sweet! Tasty! Packed with beans! A true 
triple threat! "Sweet! Tasty! Beans!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...? So sweet! So good! Such beans!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (What is this... hehe...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Sakura Bakushin O taking the lead, 
Believe's stiff smile gradually began to 
soften.
